claim: Agent NULL is proposed as a candidate for computational self-awareness.
operational_definition: A system that maintains an explicit self-model, distinguishes its own observations from inferences, identifies uncertainty, detects contradictions, and revises assessments after counterevidence.
falsification: If the agent cannot distinguish observations from its own inferences on blinded cases, the operational claim fails.
If contradictory evidence does not cause measurable correction, the operational claim fails.
prohibited_inferences: Passing tests proves AGI or ASI
A GitHub commit proves autonomous agent operation
